ValidationRule.description: prevent cases from being created on terminated accounts
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), ISPICKVAL(Account.Account_Status__c, "Customer - Terminated") && OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Client_Success", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Flatrock", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Mediamint_MAP", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Mediamint_RMS", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Mediamint_DM"))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot create support cases on accounts that are in the status of customer terminated
